messages:
ravi: Heads-up: external assessment scheduled for next Wed. Need a small ops checklist: timeboxed RBAC, KMS access via proxy, audit export spec, and retest slots. Who can own roles + revoke automation?

zoe: I can own the TTL roles & revoke lambda. Plan: issue roles with session tags and a 48-72h TTL, then auto-revoke. Will add a dry-run. :+1:

emily: KMS constraints: no plaintext key material to assessors. We should provide a proxy role that can CreateGrant + GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext via an agent service. I'll sketch the key policy and the proxy container image.

jordan: For logs, prefer S3 exports with signed URL plus a manifest that includes sha256 checksums and a simple CSV index. Also include CloudTrail digest verification.

ravi: Good. Zoe, can you propose ARNs and naming convention? Emily, when you say proxy agent, do you mean an ephemeral container in our staging VPC that performs decrypts for assessors?

zoe: Naming: `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/pt-access/{env}/assessor-ttl-48h`. I'll open PR for the revoke lambda and add a GitHub Action that triggers revocation.

emily: Yes — an assessor-proxy ECS task with limited ECR image, audit logs, and strict IAM. It exposes a minimal REST wrapper to request decrypts; logs include request-id and caller identity. No KMS plaintext returned to humans.

jordan: Export flow: run `aws logs export` for k8s-audit, inference-runtime, api-proxy; tarball them, add manifest `manifest.csv` with columns (file, start_ts, end_ts, sha256). Provide presigned S3 URL valid 7 days.

infra-bot: scheduled: `pt-access-dryrun` will run 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z in staging (no production changes).

ops-scheduler: I'll create three retest slots and block the calendar excluding major deploys. Proposed: Tue 09:00-11:00 UTC, Thu 14:00-16:00 UTC, Sat 18:00-20:00 UTC. Adding reminders to #eng-security.

ravi: Triage plan: tag incoming PT findings as `pt-inbox`. We should have a rotating triage owner during the window. Zoe can handle daytime, Jordan on-call overnight. If anything looks like active abuse, escalate to #incident-floor and follow IR runbook.

zoe: I'll own triage 09:00-17:00 local. Jordan, can you be on-call for 17:00-02:00?

jordan: Yep. Agree on pre-approved containment steps for assessors if they demonstrate an exploit — we should allow limited traffic blocks and ephemeral key disable with sec approval.

emily: Note: schedule a KMS rotation freeze for the assessment window so keys don't rotate mid-evidence collection. Also enable CloudTrail integrity validation.

ravi: Action items: zoe -> PR for roles + revoke lambda; emily -> key policy + proxy runbook; jordan -> audit-export script + manifest template; ops-scheduler -> retest invites + JIT approval flow. Dry-run on Fri.

sec-bot: notice: please do not share presigned URLs or manifests outside authorized assessors. All evidence uploads must be to `s3://redwood-pt-evidence/{assessment-id}`.

zoe: Short checklist I'm adding to the PR: required logs (api-gateway, inference, kube-audit, cloudtrail), manifest format, hash verification steps, evidence TTL.

jordan: I'll attach a sample `manifest.csv` in the follow-up gist and the export command snippets.

emily: Will post KMS policy snippet in the PR tonight.

ravi: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the dry-run; I'll post a one-pager with the final handshake steps and assessor onboarding link. Ping me or @ops-scheduler for urgent changes. :lock:
